scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @lumni/shared build && pnpm -r typecheck && tsc -p sql/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @lumni/shared build && pnpm --filter @lumni/shared test && pnpm --filter @lumni/api test && pnpm --filter @lumni/web test
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:integration && pnpm build
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages scripts infra sql "*.js" "*.json" .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages scripts infra sql "*.js" "*.json" .prettierrc.json
